population: All existing 256 queries in local_AD_grid.csv, 8 training scenes and 16 frames; all original strata preserved
feasible: finite mu, 0 < mu <= 0.4, collision == false, empty == false
top2x2: Stable descending logits over first 12 angle and first 4 depth classes; Cartesian product of first two
local4: (a1,d1), ((a1-1) mod 12,d1), ((a1+1) mod 12,d1), (a1,d1+1 if d1<3 else d1-1); no outcome-dependent choices
random4: Uniform unordered 4 distinct cells from all 48: exact oracle coverage expectation 1-C(48-m,4)/C(48,4), where m is feasible cell count
baseline_plus_random3: Supplementary budget control retaining original cell: for failed baseline 1-C(47-m,3)/C(47,3); for feasible baseline exactly 1
extra_classes: Record full-softmax angle class13 and depth class5 masses and argmax before renormalizing first12/first4
descriptive_high_marginal_low_joint: Both marginal masses >=0.5 and joint mass <0.25, descriptive cutoff only; continuous distributions also reported

bootstrap.CI: paired percentile 95%; equal weight per observed scene; only 8 scenes

width_link: Use old exact candidate caches: raw width, decoded width, qref and valid mask. qref analysis restricted to valid matches. Width saturation defined before clip: 1.2*raw_width/10 >=0.1 or <=0
interpretation: All set coverage outcomes are oracle potential at frozen width, not deployment success; no-grid-feasible is not physical ungraspability
